How many kilograms of flour does the village get?
Half of that flour is made into bread. How many kilograms is that?

problem: Tiles 13 centimeters wide are laid side by side along a 90-centimeter bathroom wall. When no more whole tiles fit, how much of the wall is still bare?
What length of a 90-inch shelf is left empty after Amir lines up as many 13-inch boxes as fit?
A rain barrel holds 40 liters and starts empty. Every bucket Pita pours in adds 7 liters. What is the fewest buckets that will fill the barrel?
follow_up_questions: Each bucket takes her 3 minutes to carry. How many minutes does she spend carrying?
She had 25 minutes before lunch. How many minutes are left?

problem: What is the smallest number of 7-gram scoops of tea needed to fill an empty jar that holds 40 grams?
follow_up_questions: Each scoop costs 3 dollars. How much do the scoops cost?
Mr Ruiz had 25 dollars. How much does he have left?

problem: A box holds 84 crayons, which the teacher splits into cups of 12. The class has 10 tables. How many cups are there?
follow_up_questions: Each cup goes to one group, and every group also gets 3 rulers. How many rulers are handed out?

problem: How many teams of 12 can a coach make from 84 players? The tournament lasts 10 days.
follow_up_questions: Each team gets 3 balls. How many balls does the coach hand out?

problem: Kito has $40 from washing cars. At the bookshop, comics are $8 each. How many comics can he buy?
follow_up_questions: Each comic has 50 pages. How many pages will Kito read if he reads them all?

problem: How many movie tickets at $8 each can a family buy with $40?
follow_up_questions: Each ticket earns 50 reward points. How many points does the family earn?

problem: Lucia spends all 27 of her arcade coins on air hockey, which costs 3 coins a game. How many games does she play?
How many rides on the merry-go-round can Omar take with 27 tickets if each ride is 3 tickets?
For the school photo, children sit in rows of 4, and the last row can be short. If thirty-four children are in the photo, how many rows are there?
follow_up_questions: Each row gets a name card that costs $6. What do the name cards cost altogether?
The teacher pays with three $20 notes. How much change does she get?

problem: How many tables are needed for 34 guests if 4 sit at each table and one table can be partly empty?
follow_up_questions: Each table gets a flower vase that costs $6. How much do the vases cost?
The host pays with three $20 notes. How much change comes back?

problem: There are 75 skiers waiting at the bottom of the mountain. A lift pass costs $9. If the cable car takes 12 skiers per trip, how many trips are needed to carry everyone up?
How many elevator rides does it take to bring 75 hotel guests to the roof party if the elevator holds 12 people? Drinks at the party cost $9.
The school band needs $96 to fix its drum set. Pupils sell cookies for $5 each. How many cookies must they sell to have enough?
follow_up_questions: After paying for the repair, how much of the cookie money is left?

problem: How many car washes at $5 each must the swim team do to raise at least $96 for new goggles?
follow_up_questions: Once the goggles are paid for, how many dollars are left over?

problem: A taxi holds 4 passengers. What is the smallest number of taxis needed so that all twenty-three wedding guests get to the party?
If 23 children go on a hay ride and each wagon holds 4, how many wagons are needed so that nobody is left out?
The hikers bring 40 bags for the mountain trek, and a donkey can carry 6 of them. Find the number of donkeys they need.
follow_up_questions: Renting a donkey costs $9. How much do the hikers pay for the donkeys?
They pay with $70. How much change do they get back?

problem: How many carts must the farmers hire if 40 sacks of corn are going to market and each cart takes 6 sacks?
follow_up_questions: One cart costs $9 for the day. What is the total rent?
The farmers hand over $70. What change should they get?

problem: Fatima saved $90 from her birthday money. She spends it on swimming lessons, which cost $15 each. The pool has a blue slide. How many lessons can she pay for?
follow_up_questions: Each lesson lasts 45 minutes. How many minutes of swimming does she get?

problem: How many guitar lessons can Leo buy with the $90 he earned walking dogs, if one lesson costs $15? His guitar has a cracked case.
follow_up_questions: A lesson lasts 45 minutes. How many minutes of lessons is that in all?

problem: Paint sets at the craft fair cost $8. With $50 in her purse, Anya buys as many as possible. What amount of money does she have left?
follow_up_questions: How many more dollars would she need for one more paint set?

problem: How much money is left after Mr Daniels buys as many $8 plants as he can with $50?
follow_up_questions: How many more dollars does he need to buy another plant?

problem: Ravi needs 75 tickets for the games he wants to play at the fair. Tickets are sold only in books of 8. Find how many books he has to buy.
How many packs of 8 hot dog buns must a cook buy if he needs 75 buns for the picnic?
The school choir raised $58 at a concert and $38 at a raffle. All of the money goes on song books that cost $4 each. How many song books can the choir buy?
follow_up_questions: The song books are put into stacks of 6. How many stacks are there?
Each stack is tied with 3 meters of string. How many meters of string is that?
String is sold in balls of 5 meters. How many balls must the choir buy?

problem: How many packets of seeds at $4 each can the garden club buy with $58 from a plant sale and $38 from a raffle?
follow_up_questions: The packets are planted in beds, 6 packets to a bed. How many beds are planted?
Each bed needs 3 bags of soil. How many bags is that?
Soil comes in pallets of 5 bags. How many pallets must the club order?

problem: How many coins does Ana have left after playing a 4-coin racing game as many times as she can with 29 coins?
A pack of 29 stickers is shared out 4 to each child, as far as it will go. Find the number of stickers left.
A scout group spent $91 on museum tickets, which cost $13 per person. A huge dinosaur skeleton stood in the hall. Find how many scouts went in.
follow_up_questions: Each scout also bought a $4 postcard. How much did the group spend on tickets and postcards together?

problem: How many children went to the zoo if the class paid $91 and each ticket was $13? It rained all morning.
follow_up_questions: Every child also got a $4 ice cream. What did the class spend on tickets and ice cream in total?

problem: A baker sorts 47 cookies into boxes of 6 for the shop. How many cookies will not fit into a full box?
follow_up_questions: Each full box sells for $3. How much money does the shop get for all the full boxes?
The loose cookies are sold for $1 each. How much does the shop make from all the cookies?

problem: How many pencils are left after Ms Rao packs 47 pencils into sets of 6, making as many full sets as she can?
follow_up_questions: A full set sells for $3. What do the full sets bring in?
Each loose pencil sells for $1. How much does she get for all the pencils?

problem: Each rowing boat seats 3 campers. If all 20 campers go out on the lake while the 2 leaders stay on shore, how many boats are needed?
follow_up_questions: Renting a boat costs $4. What do all the boats cost?
The leaders pay with a $50 note. How much change do they get?

problem: How many cars are needed to drive 20 pupils to the match if each car takes 3 pupils? The 2 coaches go by bike.
follow_up_questions: Parking costs $4 per car. What is the parking bill?
A coach pays with a $50 note. How much change comes back?

problem: How many rafts are needed so that all 32 campers can cross the river, if each raft holds 5? The water was cold and clear.
follow_up_questions: Renting one raft costs $9. What is the bill for all the rafts?

problem: A school takes 32 pupils to the theatre in taxis. Each taxi carries 5 pupils. The theatre has gold seats. Work out how many taxis are needed.
follow_up_questions: Each taxi ride costs $9. What do all the taxis cost?

problem: Beach balls cost $7 each. Lin has $95 and buys as many as she can for the beach trip. What amount of money does she have left?
follow_up_questions: Her uncle gives her $10. How many more beach balls can she buy now?
How many beach balls does she have in total?

problem: How many dollars are left after a coach buys as many $7 water bottles as she can with $95?
follow_up_questions: The team gives her $10 more. How many more bottles can she buy now?
How many bottles has she bought altogether?

problem: Pablo has $35 to spend at the school shop, where a notebook costs $5. How many notebooks can he buy?
follow_up_questions: Each notebook lasts him 8 days. How many days will all the notebooks last?

problem: With $35, how many $5 bags of birdseed can Grandma Rose buy?
follow_up_questions: Each bag feeds the birds for 8 days. How many days of food is that?

problem: A bakery packs its rolls in bags of 12, and today it baked 89 rolls. Find how many rolls are not in a full bag.
follow_up_questions: A full bag sells for $4. How much do the full bags earn?
The extra rolls go to a neighbour, along with 3 more from yesterday. How many rolls does the neighbour get?

problem: How many crayons are left after a teacher fills as many boxes of 12 as she can from 89 crayons?
follow_up_questions: Each full box is worth $4. What are the full boxes worth?
She gives the leftover crayons to a pupil, plus 3 from her desk. How many crayons does the pupil get?

problem: Zookeeper Ana has a bucket of 50 fish. She gives each seal 6 fish, feeding as many seals as she can. How many fish are still in the bucket?
follow_up_questions: There are 9 seals in the pool. How many seals still need fish?
She opens a new bucket of 20 fish and gives 6 to each hungry seal. How many fish are left in the new bucket?
She puts the leftovers from both buckets together. How many fish is that?

problem: How many apples are left in the basket after a teacher hands 6 apples to each group, starting with 50 apples and serving as many groups as she can?
follow_up_questions: The class has 9 groups. How many groups still need apples?
She opens a bag of 20 apples and gives 6 to each group that has none. How many apples are left in the bag?
How many apples are left in the basket and the bag together?

problem: Amina is spending all $32 of her savings on comic books at $4 each. Find how many comics she buys.
follow_up_questions: Each comic has 9 stories. How many stories is that in all?
Amina reads 8 stories every day. How many days will it take her to read them all?
After 4 days, how many stories does she still have to read?

problem: How many packs of trading cards at $4 each can Felix buy with $32?
follow_up_questions: Each pack holds 9 cards. How many cards is that?
He sorts 8 cards into his album each day. How many days will it take to sort them all?
How many cards are still unsorted after 4 days?

problem: Juan has 98 merit points. Every pencil case at the school shop costs 15 points, and he gets as many as he can. What number of points does he have left?
follow_up_questions: An eraser costs 4 points. How many erasers can he get with the points he has left?

problem: How many tokens remain after Zara trades her 98 tokens for as many 15-token plush toys as possible?
follow_up_questions: A keyring costs 4 tokens. How many keyrings can she get with the remaining tokens?
